family.description: This entry represents a domain found in a group of bacterial phosphoethanolamine transferases, including eptA from Helicobacter pylori [[cite:PUB00084966]] and eptB from Escherichia coli [ec:2.7.8.42] [[cite:PUB00084967]]. This domain is found immediately N-terminal to the sulphatase domain in many sulphatases.
family.name: Phosphoethanolamine transferase EptA/EptB
